golemforgetmenot.config.title: Golem Forget Me Not
golemforgetmenot.config.visitsUntilCoold: How many chests a copper golem inspects before it forgets them all and starts its cooldown. Vanilla: 10.
golemforgetmenot.config.completeStacks.t: Golems fill existing partial stacks before using empty slots.
golemforgetmenot.config.heightReach.tool: How high a copper golem can reach chests. Vanilla: 2. Values above 4 are likely to break.
